decision: open + 60 min + 1s. 12 complete aligned 5-minute bars. One long nomination per session per book of research, largest open-to-close log return minus XLK return, ties by symbol.
simple: Last closed bar close strictly above the first 30-minute high. Require same valid input history as CONFIRMED.
confirmed: SIMPLE plus penultimate close above range high, positive relative return vs XLK, last 10 minute volume above median of same interval over previous 20 completed sessions.
stop: Distance from decision close to low of first 30 minutes; same native stop distance, partials and 30bp IOC for both rules.
controls: SIMPLE and CASH, same starting equity, limits, unit costs, dates and fixed overhead.
support: At least 20 closed campaigns per cost case and 100 sessions, positive net after removing the largest winner.
gate: Reject on nonpositive net or drawdown >8% or session loss >2% in either scenario. Otherwise require support plus positive absolute and paired log-growth lower bounds against SIMPLE and CASH in each scenario and both blocks. Eligible only for a future trial.
execution: Historical OHLCV only. No quotes, fills or measured queue. Split crossing the asset volume lookback invalidates its window. Dividends only in ledger. Same technical signals across both cost cases; account paths can differ.
history: Reused prices. No fitted weights, parameter search, new holdout, promotion, or live orders.
